rules: scope task: an ID a task profile, a launch domain and a selection slot may name; profile true: it may carry a weight in a task profile; scope layer: a strength cell of the selection layer only, never a task profile or a launch domain; f02: a member of the frozen nine of the class registry (PROTO-DEC-0084 item 2). A facet, a crosswalk label and the quarantine bucket are bank labels, never IDs: a facet qualifies a cell, a crosswalk label is resolved by the benchmark crosswalk per family, and the quarantine bucket is never a number. A removed ID is refused everywhere and names its replacement.
